data.name: Roshinika
data.gender_notes: Roshinika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Roshinika is derived from the Sanskrit words 'rosha' meaning 'moon' and 'niketana' meaning 'residence'. It signifies the one who radiates the light of the moon and illuminates the path for others. The name Roshinika carries the meaning “The radiance of the moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Roshinika usually hope their child will grow to embody the radiance of the moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner radiance of a person, reflecting their enlightened soul.
data.etymology: Roshinika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “The radiance of the moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Roshinika total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

vedic_reference.note: रोशिनिका (Roshini) is a combination of Roshana (light) and Ratri (night).

historical_references.reference: Roshinika was a celebrated Jaina nun and scholar in the 13th century CE. She is believed to have been born in Karnataka and was a close disciple of the Jaina philosopher and saint, Chandragombhara Swami. Roshinika is known for her profound knowledge of Jaina scriptures and philosophy, and she was a prolific writer and commentator. Her works include commentaries on the Agamashastra and the Nyayashastra, as well as original works on Jaina ethics and philosophy.

Roshinika is also mentioned in the Purana literature as the wife of the Pandava prince Bhima in the Mahabharata. In this context, she is described as a beautiful and virtuous woman who was highly respected by Bhima and his brothers. While the historical accuracy of this reference is uncertain, it underscores the reverence in which Roshinika was held in Hindu society.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Roshinika is gaining popularity among modern Hindu parents. It is a beautiful Sanskrit name meaning 'Goddess of virtue and knowledge'. It is seen on various platforms such as social media, babynames websites, and parenting forums where parents are discussing unique and meaningful names for their babies. The trend towards giving children Hindu names with deep spiritual meaning continues to grow in popularity.
